item.title: Delcy Rodríguez Takes Charge as Interim President of Venezuela Amid Political Turmoil
item.description: GUWAHATI: Delcy Rodríguez has assumed office as Venezuela’s interim president, taking over the country’s top post following the abrupt removal of President Nicolás Maduro. Rodríguez, who earlier served as vice president and oil minister, was sworn in on January 5, 2026, at a ceremony held at the National Assembly in Caracas. item.title: India Eases Business Travel for Chinese Professionals with e-B-4 Visa
item.description: GUWAHATI: India has introduced a new e-Production Investment Business Visa, known as the e-B-4 Visa, allowing Chinese businessmen to travel to the country for specific short-term business and industrial activities. The visa, which came into effect on January 1, can be applied for entirely online without visiting the Indian Embassy or using visa agents. item.description: GUWAHATI: With Assembly elections expected in the next few months, confusion persists among several voters in Guwahati over their Legislative Assembly Constituencies (LACs), even years after delimitation was carried out. A few residents say they remain unsure about which constituency they fall under, raising concerns about voter awareness ahead of the polls. item.title: Russell Peters to Perform in Shillong on March 27 as Part of 2026 India Tour
item.description: GUWAHATI: Shillong is set to welcome one of the biggest names in global stand-up comedy, as Russell Peters brings his Relax World Tour to Meghalaya on March 27, 2026. item.title: Schools in Kamrup Metro to Start Late from Jan 7 as Cold Wave Prompts Change in Timings
